translation.name: Mushog Testamento
translation.englishName: Huamalíes-Dos de Mayo Huánuco Quechua NT

content: Jesucristuta wanusiyänanpä mandag cüracuna wilanacuyashgan
Sayno yacharcasirmi discïpuluncunata Jesús nergan:
“Musyayashgayquinöpis Pascua galaycunanpä ishcay junaglanami pishiycan. Saychömi runacuna nogata crucificamangapä.”
Saypita mandag cüracuna y Israel mayor runacuna shuntacäyargan más mandag cüra Caifaspa wayinman.
Saychömi wilanacuyargan runacunata mana musyasiylapa Jesusta sarircur wanusiyänanpä.
Saymi wilanacuyargan: “Fiestachöga ama sarishunsu. Fiestacho sarishgaga contransimi runacuna sharcuyangapä” nir.
Jesucristupa umanman perfümita warmi winapashgan
Saypitanami Betania marcaman Jesús aywargan lepröso niyashgan Simonpa wayinman.

Saymanmi juc warmi chargan “alabastro” nishgan rumipita rurashgan botëllanwan perfümin aptash. Say perfümega selläma chaninmi cargan. Mësacho Jesús caycaptinmi say warmega paypa umanman say perfümita winapargan.
Discïpuluncuna sayta ricar rabiashpan niyargan: “¿Imapätä waläla jichar perdisish say perfümita?
Sayno perdisinanpa trucanga nogansita goycamashwan cargan ali chanincho ranticuycur muchogcunata yanapänansipä.”
Say nishgancunata wiyarmi Jesús nergan: “Cay warmi alitami ruraycan. Sayno caycaptenga ¿imanirtä payta jamuraycäyanqui?
Muchogcunaga yanapäyänayquipä imaypis caycäyangami. Nogami isanga gamcunawan cashäpänasu.
Pampash canäpämi cay warmega perfümita winapämar alistaycäman.
Perfümita cay warmi winapämashgantaga may-saychöpis musyayangami.”
Jesucristuta entregananpä mandag cüracunawan Judas Iscariote conträtuta rurashgan
Saypitanami Jesuspa discïpulun Judas Iscariote aywargan mandag cüracunaman.

Chaycurmi paycunata nergan: “Runacuna mana cashgancho Jesusta prësu sariyänayquipä wilaptë ¿aycatatä pägayämanquipä?” nishpan. Sayno niptinmi: “Nogacuna pägayäshayqui quimsa chunca (30) yurag guellaytami” nishpan guellayta yupapasquiyargan.
Sayno päguta chasquircurmi Judas yarpachacorgan imay höra wilacog cutinanpäpis.
Pascua merendata discïpuluncunawan Jesucristo micushgan
Levadüraynag Tantata Micunan fiesta galaycunan junagmi discïpuluncuna Jesusta tapuyargan: “¿Maychötä puestucayämushä Pascua merendata micunansipä, taytay?”
Sayno niyaptinmi Jesús nergan: “Marcaman aywar juc runata niyanqui: ‘Wanunanpä höran cercana captinshi discïpuluncunawan Pascua merendata wayiquicho micuyta munaycan.’ ”
Jesús yäsishgannöla aywarmi discïpuluncunaga Pascua merendata say wayicho puestucuyargan.
Pasa sacaycaptinnami chunca ishcay (12) acrashgan cag discïpuluncunawan Jesús mësa cagman jamacuyargan.
Saymi micuycäyashgancho Jesús nergan: “Gamcunapita jucniquimi chiquimagnëcunapa maquinman entregamangapä.”
Niptin laquicuyashpan jucnin jucnin Jesusta tapuyargan: “¿Nogasurä caycä, taytay?” niyashpan.
Saymi Jesús nergan: “Plätucho nogawan juntu tantata ushmaseg cagmi chiquimagnëcunapa maquinman entregamangapä.
Tayta Diospa palabrancho guelgaraycashgannöla fiyupa nacar wanunäpämi caycä. Nogata entregamag runami isanga juicio finalcho fiyupa laquicongapä. Payga ama yurinmanpissu cargan.”
Sayno niptinmi contran sharcog Judasga Jesusta taporgan: “¿Nogasurä caycä, taytay?” Niptin Jesús nergan: “Quiquiquimi nishcanqui.”
Santa Cënata discïpuluncunawan Jesucristo upushgan
Saypitanami tantata aptarcur Tayta Diosta Jesús manacur agradëcicorgan. Nircurnami paquircur paquircur discïpuluncunata ayporgan: “Cay tantata lapayqui micuyay. Cay tantaga cuerpömi” nishpan.
Saynölami vïnuyog väsuta aptarcur Tayta Diosta manacur agradëcicorgan. Nircurnami discïpuluncunata macyargan: “Lapayqui cay vïnuta upuyay.
Cay vïnoga yawarnëmi. Yawarnëta jichar wanushgä hörami Tayta Dios mushog conträtuta ruranga pï-maytapis chasquicamagcunata perdonananpä.
Yapayga manami vïnuta upushänasu Tayta Diospa naupancho gamcunawan upushgansiyag.”
Salmucunata cantasquirnami discïpuluncunawan Jesús aywayargan Olivos lömaman.
Pedro ñëgananpä cagta Jesucristo nishgan

Olivos lömaman chaycurmi Jesús nergan: “Canan sacay lapayqui cachariycamarmi gueshpir aywacuyanquipä. Tayta Diosninsipa palabranchöpis caynömi nican: ‘Uysha misegta wanuycasiptë uyshancuna mashtacarmi aywacuyanga.’
Sayno captinpis wanushgäpita cawarircamur gamcunapita más puntatami Galileaman aywashä saycho tincunansipä.”
Sayno niptinmi Pedro nergan: “Waquin cag cachariyäshuptiquipis nogaga manami cachashayquipäsu, taytay.”
Sayno niptinmi Pedruta Jesús nergan: “Canan sacay cacash manarä cantaptinmi quimsa cuti reguimashgayquita ñëgamanquipä.”
Sayno niptinmi Pedro nergan: “¡Ishcansita wanusimänansi captinpis manami ñëgashayquipäsu, taytay!” Waquin cag discïpuluncunapis saynölami niyargan.
Getsemanïcho Tayta Diosta Jesucristo manacushgan
Olivos lömacho caycag Getsemaní huertaman discïpuluncunawan chaycurmi Jesús nergan: “Tayta Diosta manacamushgäyag gamcuna caylacho jamaraycäyay.”
Nircur Pedruta y Zebedeupa surincuna Santiagutawan Juanta más washaläman pushargan. Saychömi fiyupa laquicur nergan:
“Wanunayparämi laquicuy sarimash. Gamcunapis Tayta Diosta manacushpayqui caylacho shuyaraycäyämay.”

Sayno nircurmi más washaläman aywargan Tayta Diosta manacunanpä. Saychömi gongurpacuycorgan urcunpis pampaman töpashganyag. Sayno gongurpacuycurmi Tayta Diosta manacorgan: “Papá, nacanäpä caycashgäpita salvaycalämay. Isanga noga munashgänöga ama casunsu, sinöga gam munashgayquino cayculäsun.”
Sayno manacushganpita cutishpanmi tarergan quimsan discïpuluncuna punucash caycagta. Saymi Pedruta nergan: “Tayta Diosta manacushgäyag ¿manacu juc höralapis ricchayta camäpacuyashcanqui?
Punushgayquipita ricchayayna. Diosta manacuyay Satanasta mana cäsupäyänayquipä. Cäsupayta mana munarpis Tayta Diosta mana manacorga cäsupäyanquipämi.”
Sayno nircurmi yapay cutiycur Tayta Diosta manacorgan: “Runacuna nacasimar wanusimänanpä captinpis gam munashgayquino cayculäsun, papá.”
Tayta Diosta manacushganpita yapay cutiycur tarergan quimsan discïpuluncuna pasaypa punucash caycagta.
Sayno caycagta ricaycurpis yapay cutiycurmi Tayta Diosta manacorgan puntata manacushgannöla.

Saypitanami yapay cutiycur paycunata nergan: “¿Cananpis gamcuna jinalacu punuycäyanqui? ¡Ricchayayna! Tayta Diospita shamush captëpis höra chämushganami jusasapa runacunapa maquinman nogata entregayämänanpä.
¡Sharcuyayna! Chiquimagnëcunapa maquinman entregamänanpä cag runa shamuycannami.”
Jesucristuta prësu sariyashgan

Discïpuluncunawan Jesús parlaycaptinmi Judas Iscariote chargan asca runacunata pushash. Judasga Jesuspa discïpulunmi cargan. Say runacunami chäyargan espädancuna y garrotincuna aptash. Jesusta prësu sariyänanpä say runacunata cachargan mandag cüracuna y Israel mayor runacunami.
Sayman manarä charmi Judasga pushashgan runacunata yäsergan: “Mayganpis musashgä cagmi Jesusga caycan. Payta prësu sariyanqui” nir.
Saymi chaycur Judasga Jesusta saludashpan musaycorgan.
Sayno saludaptinmi Jesús nergan: “Judas, ¿caymanpis shamuycunquiräcu?” Sayno niptinmi runacunaga Jesusta jucla prësu sariyargan.
Prësu sariyaptinmi espädanta jorgurishpan juc discïpulun más mandag cürapa ashmayninpa rinrinta waluriycorgan.
Sayno ruraptinmi Jesús nergan: “Espädayquita cutisiy churaräcunanman. Pipis espädawan runa mayinta wanuseg cäga espädawanmi wanusish canga.
¿Gam manacu musyanqui Tayta Diosta manacuptëga washämänanpä chunca ishcay (12) tröpa
angilcunata cachamunanpä cashganta?
Washämänanpä manacuptëga ¿imanöparä cumplicanga runacuna wanusiyämänanpä Tayta Diospa palabrancho guelgaraycashganpis?”

Nircurna say runacunata Jesús nergan: “¿Imanirtä suwa captënöpis gamcuna shayämushcanqui espädayquicunawan y garrotiquiwanpis prësu sariyämänayquipä? Nogaga waran waranmi templo patiucho yachasergä. ¿Imanirtä saychöga prësu sariyämargayquisu?

Sayno captinpis prësu sariyämänayquipä gamcuna shayämuptiquimi Tayta Diosninsipa profëtancuna guelgayashgan cumplicaycan.” Jesusta prësu sariyaptinnami discïpuluncuna gueshpir aywacuyargan japalanta cachaycur.
Más mandag cüra Jesucristuta tapushgan
Jesusta prësu sarircurmi apayargan más mandag cüra Caifaspa wayinman. Saychömi Moisés guelgashganta yachasegcuna y Israel mayor runacunapis shuntacash caycäyargan.

Jesusta sayman apayaptinmi caru guepalanta Pedro gatirargan. Caifaspa wayinman chaycur paypis yaycorgan patio rurinyag. Sayman yaycurir templo täpag wardiacunawan jamaraycargan ima päsashgantapis ricananpä.
Mandag cüracunawan autoridäcunanaga imanöpapis Jesusta wanusiyänantami munayargan. Saymi ashiyargan pilapis Jesús mana parlacushganta jitapänanpä.
Sayno ashiptin ascagmi Jesús mana parlacushganta jitapäyargan. Sayno jitapäyaptinpis manami ima jusantapis tariyargansu wanusish cananpä. Saypita ishcay runacuna niyargan:
“Cay runaga nergan templuta juchurasir quimsa junaglata yapay sharcasinanpämi.”
Saymi más mandag cüra Jesusta taporgan: “¿Manacu imatapis ninqui sayno jitapäshuptiqui? ¿Imanirtä contrayqui sayno parlaycäyan?”

Sayno tapuptinpis manami imatapis Jesús parlacorgansu. Saymi más mandag cüra nergan: “Lapanpä munayyog Tayta Dios ricaycämashgami gamta tapö: ¿Rasunpacu Tayta Dios cachamushgan Cristo caycanqui? Saynöpis ¿rasunpacu Diospa surin canqui?”

Sayno tapuptinmi Jesús nergan: “Au, nishgayquino rasunpaypami caycä. Saymi nogata ricayämanquipä lapanpä munayyog Tayta Diospa derëcha cag naupancho jamaraycagta. Saynöpis pucutay janancho shamuycagtami ricayämanquipä.”

Sayno niptin más mandag cüra fiyupa rabiashpan sotänantapis rachir ushar nergan: “¡Cay runaga Dios-tucuycanmi! Sayno nicaptenga ¿imapänatä más testïgutapis ashishun? Gamcuna wiyayashcanquimi Dios-tucur parlaycashganta.
Sayno captenga ¿imaniyanquitä?” Sayno niptinmi saycho caycag runacuna niyargan: “¡Jusayogmi caycan! ¡Wanusish casun!”
Sayno nirmi Jesuspa cäranman togapäyargan y cutayargan. Waquinnami lagyar ushayargan:
“Tayta Diosninsi cachamushgan Cristo carga mä niyämay pï magashushgayquitapis” nir.
Jesucristuta Pedro ñëgashgan
Sayyäga Pedro jamaraycargan sawan rurinchömi. Saycho jamaraycagta ricarmi juc ashmay jipash nergan: “Gamta ricashcä Galileapita cag Jesuswan puriycagtami.”
Sayno niptinmi lapan runacuna wiyaycäyaptin Pedro nergan: “Manami musyäsu imapita parlapaycämashgayquitapis.”
Sayno nircurmi Pedroga puncu naupanman aywargan. Saychöpis juc jipash payta ricaycur runacunata nergan: “Nogapis cay runataga ricargä Nazaretpita cag Jesuswan puriycagtami.”
Sayno niptin Pedro jurashpan nergan: “¡Nogaga manami reguësu say runataga!”
Saypita maylantana saycho caycag runacuna Pedruman aywaycur niyargan: “¡Gamga rasunpaypami paywan pureg canqui! Parlacuyniquipis pay-niragmi caycan.”
Sayno niyaptinmi Pedro jurashpan nergan: “¡Say runaga pishi cacunpis! ¡Paytaga manami reguësu!” Sayno nicaptinmi cacash cantarcorgan.

Sayno cantarcuptinmi Pedro jinan höra yarparcorgan Jesús cayno nishganta: “Manarä cacash cantaptinmi quimsa cuti reguimashgayquita ñëgamanquipä.” Say nishganta yarparcurmi Pedro wagtaman yargusquir fiyupa laquicushpan maquinta chogpacurcur wagargan.

footnotes.text: Say wisan juc tröpacho cargan sogta waranga (6,000) soldäducuna. Saymi Jesús nergan ganchis chunca ishcay waranga (72,000) angilcunata cachamunanpä cashganta.
